add.title: US proposes tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods under Section 301, offering a reduced 17% rate if bilateral trade negotiations succeed
India's proposed cross-border insolvency framework faces delays over concerns about forum shopping and creditor protection, with implementing rules unlikely to be finalised this fiscal year
Finance Ministry tightens oversight of infrastructure projects, requiring detailed explanations and revised timelines for cost overruns exceeding 10% before approving additional budgetary allocations
Government notifies transfer-pricing tolerance limits of 1% for wholesale traders and 3% for other businesses, affecting related-party transactions for assessment year 2026–27
India records its largest monthly net FDI outflow in at least 15 years at $4.95 billion in September, amid rising repatriations and overseas investments
Government-appointed panel recommends using granular GST returns, corporate filings and administrative records to overhaul state and district GDP estimation, replacing fixed ratios and proxies
RBI analysis finds inflation increasingly widespread across goods, services and regions, with October retail inflation reaching 6.09% and complicating December monetary-policy decisions
India extends duty-free raw sugar import deadline to March 31, 2027, and refining deadline to September 30, supporting domestic supply amid elevated prices
SEBI considers further liberalising specialised investment fund regulations to provide greater investment flexibility, as the emerging fund category reaches approximately ₹48,000 crore in assets
Meta's India content restrictions surge over 13,000% to 54.39 lakh items, while Google's government takedown requests rise 61%, highlighting intensified digital-content regulation
